items.title: hermes-agent
items.description: The agent that grows with you — a self-improving AI agent with built-in learning loop, skill creation from experience, cross-session memory, and multi-platform messaging support (Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal).
items.readme_excerpt: Hermes Agent — The self-improving AI agent built by Nous Research. It creates skills from experience, improves them during use, nudges itself to persist knowledge, searches its own past conversations, and builds a deepening model of who you are across sessions. Run it on a $5 VPS, a GPU cluster, or serverless infrastructure. Supports 200+ models via OpenRouter, NVIDIA NIM, Hugging Face, OpenAI, and custom endpoints. Features include TUI, messaging gateway, cron scheduler, subagent delegation, and RL training readiness.

items.title: claude-mem
items.description: A Claude Code plugin that automatically captures everything Claude does during your coding sessions, compresses it with AI (using Claude's agent-sdk), and injects relevant context back into future sessions.
items.readme_excerpt: Claude-Mem — Persistent memory compression system built for Claude Code. Seamlessly preserves context across sessions by automatically capturing tool usage observations, generating semantic summaries, and making them available to future sessions. Features include progressive disclosure, skill-based search, web viewer UI, MCP search tools with 3-layer workflow (search → timeline → get_observations), Chroma vector database for hybrid search, and support for Gemini CLI and OpenCode.

items.readme_excerpt: 《动手学大模型》系列编程实践教程 — 由上海交通大学《自然语言处理前沿技术》课程讲义拓展而来，旨在提供大模型相关的入门编程参考。教程内容包括：微调与部署、提示学习与思维链、知识编辑、数学推理、模型水印、越狱攻击、大模型隐写、多模态模型、GUI智能体、智能体安全、RLHF安全对齐等。另联合华为昇腾推出国产化《大模型开发全流程》公益教程。

items.title: voicebox
items.description: The open-source AI voice studio. Clone, dictate, create.
items.readme_excerpt: Voicebox — The open-source voice synthesis studio. A free and open-source alternative to ElevenLabs. Clone voices from a few seconds of audio or pick from 50+ preset voices, generate speech in 23 languages across 7 TTS engines (Qwen3-TTS, LuxTTS, Chatterbox, TADA, Kokoro), apply post-processing effects, and compose multi-voice projects with a timeline editor. Built with Tauri (Rust), runs locally on macOS, Windows, and Linux with GPU support.

items.title: openai-agents-python
items.description: A lightweight, powerful framework for multi-agent workflows
items.readme_excerpt: OpenAI Agents SDK — A lightweight yet powerful framework for building multi-agent workflows. Provider-agnostic, supporting OpenAI Responses and Chat Completions APIs plus 100+ other LLMs. Core concepts include Agents, Sandbox Agents, Agents as tools, Handoffs, Tools (functions, MCP, hosted), Guardrails, Human-in-the-loop, Sessions, Tracing, and Realtime Agents for voice. New in v0.14.0: Sandbox Agents for filesystem and command execution in containerized environments.
